{{Quote|This meatless option comes from a pleasantly rustic Outer Rim agriworld. The patty is made from Agamarian soybeans and topped with a thick slice of binka fruit and mugruebe spit-sauce.|Dex's Diner menu on its Agamar slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Mugruebe spit-sauce''' was a type of [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]] used in the [[Agamar slider]]s served [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Foodstuff/Legends|sauce]] shared its name with the [[mugruebe]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|341|mugruebe}}</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas" /> planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mugruebe spit-sauce was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
